info.name: Banu (Bano) API
info.description:
Full Postman collection for the Banu (Bano) Laravel API — with sample request bodies AND sample response payloads on every endpoint.

## Setup
1. Import this collection.
2. In **Variables**, set `base_url` (default `http://localhost:8080/api`) and `external_api_key` (matches `WORDPRESS_MISSIONARY_API_KEY` in `.env`).
3. Run **Auth → Login** — the test script auto-saves the token into `{{token}}` and every authenticated request picks it up via Bearer auth.

## Response envelope
All JSON responses follow `{ success: boolean, message: string, data: any }`. Errors add an `errors` field with field-level details (e.g. validation).

## Pagination envelope
Paginated lists wrap items: `data: { items: [...], meta: { current_page, per_page, total, last_page } }`.

## Auth
Most routes use Laravel Sanctum bearer tokens. The External endpoint uses the `X-External-Api-Key` header instead.

## Tip — using the saved examples
Open any request → **Examples** dropdown (top right) to inspect the `200`, `201`, `401`, `403`, `404`, or `422` sample payloads.

Public. Returns all cities of the given province, sorted by name. Use this to populate the city dropdown once the user has chosen a province.

request.description: Authenticated. Returns the current user's stored register-data as a flat `{ key: value }` object. Empty `{}` when nothing has been saved yet.

Authenticated. Upserts the supplied key/value pairs into the current user's register-data store. Existing keys are updated; new keys are inserted. Returns the full set after the write. Values can be any JSON scalar or structure.

request.description: Submit homework by referencing a media row previously uploaded via POST /media with purpose=homework_file. Resubmitting replaces the previous file; an already-accepted submission is rejected.
`status`: accepted | denied.

formdata.description: One of: avatar, cover, video, voice, pdf, slide, attachment, homework_file. Determines disk, allowed extensions, max size, and the collection the media will live in once attached.

request.description: Single upload endpoint. Returns the created media row with its `id`; the row is in a pending state (`model_id` null, `uploaded_by` set to the current user) until you reference it from an entity create/update endpoint via `*_media_id` or `media_ids[]`. Pending uploads are cleaned up automatically after `MEDIA_PENDING_TTL_HOURS` (default 24).

request.description: Streams a file. Auth depends on owner type. Admin can download anything.
